description: CATO c1 (Arc 63 pass A, non-blocking). check-bw-release/check.sh:120 issues 'curl -fsSL' with no --max-time. The SessionStart substrate-check hook bounds it with 'timeout 10' so the non-blocking boot guarantee HOLDS and fail-open is intact -- but the bare curl is a latent hygiene gap if the script is ever invoked outside the hook's timeout wrapper. PLAN: add '--max-time 8' (or similar) to the curl at check.sh:120 in both substrate/ + .claude/ copies; one-line change, no behavior change under normal network. Defer-rationale: pre-existing, not introduced by Arc 63; out of the pass-A deliverable surface (the hook correctly bounds it). Fix in pass B or a standalone hygiene commit.
title: [FOLLOW-UP arc-63] check-bw-release/check.sh:120 curl lacks --max-time (pre-existing; hook bounds it)
